Global inflation concerns linked to Iran conflict
Euro zone inflation expectations are surging

en.title: US GDP Growth Probability Declines
en.summary: The probability of US GDP growth between 3.0% and 3.5% in Q1 2026 has dropped to 5%. This decline is driven by concerns over rising core inflation linked to higher oil prices, as reported by an 81% majority in a CNBC survey.
drivers: 81% of respondents expect higher oil prices to raise inflation
GM's earnings report highlights cost pressures from geopolitical tensions
United Arab Emirates leaving OPEC may impact oil supply
en.why_matters: Rising inflation could lead to tighter monetary policy, affecting economic growth. Understanding these dynamics is crucial for investors and policymakers.
en.bull_case: If inflation stabilizes and oil prices decline, GDP growth could exceed expectations.
en.bear_case: Continued inflation and geopolitical tensions could hinder economic growth, keeping GDP below target.
